critique: The collision-uniform Lipschitz modulus, estimators, confidence sets, and cluster report are proved only over the uniformly conditioned class \(\mathcal M\), which adds fixed joint latent-arm and proxy singular-value margins; collision-uniform inference over the full published VMW structural class is not established. The matched quotient-law and labeled-weight minimax conclusions are narrower still, holding only for \(k=d_x=d_z=2\) with fixed numerical class constants, whereas general fixed \(k\) receives upper and inference guarantees without a matching converse. For larger published comparator classes, only the two-point lower bounds transfer, not achievability, confidence, or clustering guarantees. The unresolved exact computation of the original summary-inversion image is correctly confined to a computational sharpening, so the framing does not falsely claim that residual is solved.
